turns.speaker: agent
turns.name: Halberd
turns.text: Hi, this is Halberd, the automated verification line for the School District's business office. Am I speaking with Bright Bus Lines?

turns.speaker: vendor
turns.name: Tom Reyes
turns.text: Yeah, this is Tom in billing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.name: Halberd
turns.text: Thanks, Tom. We received invoice #14, for $4,180.00, asking us to pay a new account at Harbor Point Bank. Did Bright Bus Lines send that request?

turns.speaker: vendor
turns.name: Tom Reyes
turns.text: No... that wasn't us. We haven't changed banks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.name: Halberd
turns.text: Thank you. We won't pay that invoice. Your account on file stays the same.
